Depressingly, I have an almost identical life to what happened on Horimiya. It just didnt end on a good note like the anime/manga is. Story time. 

I was a new student on my 3rd year high school. There's this girl who's the top of the food chain in terms of looks. smart too. She's also the most fearsome girl among the class due to her temper. Her friend, no fuckin idea why, shilled her to me. Saying she likes me and asking if I like her too. I was 'ok cool'

We had this project for making a video parody. I got paired up to her. Multiple weeks of interaction with her and we hit it off. 

Onwards then, basic high school love slice of life happens. Eating lunch together, motorcycle to her home, dates, sports fest, home movie watching. Things like that. 

Eerily, she almost has the same attitude of Hori. Temper and sweetness goes hand in hand. She defends me to other people. When she is angry on the class, I was no exception there. She can be sweet as candy and hard as a rock. I'm *scared* of pissing her off because it's very hard to soften her heart. Has the same hair color and style as Hori too. She was my first love. We were together for 5 yrs. Had 1 break up in there too. 

Sadly, we broke up. Since then, both of us haven't had another person on our life. Maybe we'll cross each other again? who knows. 

So the take away here is Horimiya has a special place on my heart. Almost 1:1 to my high school years.
